messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: our dependency scanner flagged a cluster of infra-facing CVEs impacting vLLM, Triton, FlashAttention kernels, protobuf and sentencepiece. Need quick triage and an agreed deploy plan.

sec-bot: Auto-scan digest: CVE-2025-AB12 (protobuf) - HIGH, CVE-2025-CD34 (triton kernel) - HIGH (requires CUDA change), CVE-2025-EF56 (flashattention) - MEDIUM, CVE-2025-GH78 (sentencepiece) - LOW. Full report: https://redwood.internal/vuln/INC-2314

simon: I'll coordinate runtime validation and rollout. Can we get exploitability notes + patch matrix from the tracker?

kevin: Triton upstream patch depends on CUDA runtime >= 12.2 and new libcudnn. Our staging fleet is on 12.1. Image rebuild will be ~2h plus validation.

oliver: Ops availability: we can schedule a driver upgrade window 2025-04-02 01:30-04:00 UTC. Plan to canary the driver on staging-prod1 then expand.

jess: vLLM and sentencepiece patches are pure-python wheel bumps (minor). I'll run the ML regression and safety suites once wheels are pushed.

maria: Compliance note: any new runtime principal created for the deploy path must have KMS access reviewed and keys rotated at provisioning time. We cannot skip rotation per policy. @sec-bot confirm audit forwarders.

sec-bot: Confirmed. Required IAM role: runtime-kms-deployer. Audit events will land in projects/redwood-prod -> CLOUD_AUDIT_LOGS. Key rotation recommended during provisioning: see /policies/kms-runtime-deploy.md.

kevin: Can we avoid immediate rotation? Rotation will extend the window by ~30-45m.

maria: No, we must rotate for any new principal. Ops: include key-ceremony and rotation steps in the runbook.

oliver: A couple infra constraints to call out:
- Kernel upgrade on GPU nodes needs reboot, so plan for node drains.
- Canary scope: 3 pods on prod1 as a canary group.

simon: Proposed rollout (high-level):
1) run driver upgrade on staging nodes (canary)
2) build patched Triton image + protobuf/sentencepiece wheels
3) deploy to staging runtime, run perf + safety harness
4) canary on prod: 5% traffic for 15m, then 25% for 30m, then 50% for 30m, health gates at each step
5) full rollout with automated gating and 15m stabilization windows
Rollback knobs: image tag revert, rollback to pinned model weights, re-enable previous driver if necessary.

simon: Important SLO checks for canary: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 500ms; error rate < 0.5%. Trigger immediate rollback if p95 regresses >10% vs baseline OR error rate >0.5%.

jess: Test steps for staging (short):
```
# build and install artifacts
./deploy/triton/build.sh --tag=triton-patch-2025-04
pip wheel -w /tmp/wheels protobuf==4.24.0 sentencepiece==0.1.96
# deploy to staging runtime
./deploy/staging/deploy_runtime.sh --image triton-patch-2025-04 --wheels /tmp/wheels
# run perf + safety
./tools/eval/run_suite --suite core-latency --backend triton-staging
./tools/eval/run_suite --suite safety --backend triton-staging
```

oliver: Canary throttling plan: 5% for 15m, then 25% for 30m, then 50% for 30m. Abort if error rate >0.5% or any safety test fails. Ops will notify #oncall 20m before canary.

maria: Add RBAC checklist items: ensure runtime-kms-deployer role is least-privilege, bind to service identity only for the rollout, verify AuditLog entries during canary. Also update the compliance ticket INC-2314 with the runbook steps.

kevin: I'll prepare the patched images and a migration plan for CUDA 12.2. Also will bench the images for memory and tail latency.

jess: I'll schedule ML regression runs immediately after the staging deploy. If any safety tests fail, we block canary and escalate.

simon: I'll draft the runbook & health checks, and push the PRs (runtime + infra) today. Expect staging canary in ~48h.

oliver: Ops will run the key-ceremony and rotation in the maintenance window. I'll attach the checklist to the ticket and call the oncall 20m prior.

maria: Owners and action items: simon (runtime runbook + coord), jess (ml tests), kevin (image + CUDA plan), oliver (ops window + KMS rotation), maria (compliance + ticket). I'll create INC-2314-DEPLOY and assign tasks.

simon: ack. Please add any blockers in the ticket.

oliver: Note: we'll enable extended audit retention for the window and capture additional debug logs for 2h post-deploy.

maria: Thanks all. If no blockers, we'll treat this as high priority and aim for the April 2nd window. :white_check_mark:
